description: RegForg evaluation set covering two books: 'The Hundred-Page Machine Learning Book' (MachineLearning-3.pdf) and 'Learning Python' (Learning_Python-2.pdf). Each answerable question names its document; a retrieved chunk only counts if both the document and the page match. Page numbers are 1-based PDF pages (what a PDF viewer shows). Relevant pages were labelled from each book's section headings (for Learning Python, the PDF's bookmark outline), not from retriever output. Questions with answerable=false are out of scope for both books and the system must refuse them.
